exposure: number of risk factors for sepsis
cohort: 1232 babies with at least one risk factor for sepsis (as defined by the National Neonatology Forum (NNF) 2021 guidelines) at the Special Newborn Care Unit, GMC Thrissur.
finding: The empirical use of antibiotics in infants at risk of EONS did not show a favorable effect on the incidence of EONS or sepsis-related mortality.
birth_weight: lower birth weight infants were more susceptible to developing sepsis
